summary.text: Terry Le is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Demi Palecek for a seat with no incumbent.
He ran for the same district in 2024 and lost to incumbent Hoan Huynh.

paragraphs.text: Terry Le was born in Chicago, Illinois, and earned a high school diploma from Amundsen High School.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2017 to 2018, and his career experience includes working as a caregiver, businessman, machine operator and restaurant worker.
Le received 12.3 percent of the vote against Hoan Huynh in the November 5, 2024 general election for District 13.
He advanced from the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.
